settings.label: Website ID
settings.meaning: Which Crisp website the chat widget opens and the REST operations act on. It's in every page that shows the widget.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Workspace Settings › Setup & Integrations: the Website ID in the chatbox code. Crisp has no test mode: use a separate website (workspace) for test.

settings.label: API token identifier
settings.meaning: The first half of the REST API token, sent with the key as Basic authentication. Only the REST operations need it.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Workspace Settings › Advanced configuration › API Token › Generate Token (an owner only; shown once). For a Marketplace plugin's token instead, set CRISP_TOKEN_TIER=plugin.

settings.label: API token key
settings.meaning: The secret half of the REST API token.
settings.whereToFind: Shown once, beside the identifier, when the API token is generated.

settings.label: API token kind
settings.meaning: website (the default) for a token generated in the workspace's settings; plugin for a Marketplace plugin's token. Sent as the X-Crisp-Tier header.
settings.whereToFind: website, unless the token came from a plugin at marketplace.crisp.chat (Tokens › Production, installed on the website).

settings.label: Identity verification secret
settings.meaning: Signs the signed-in user's email for the chat widget, so a visitor can't claim to be someone else, and derives each user's session token. Only chatIdentity needs it.
settings.whereToFind: Settings › Workspace Settings › Advanced configuration › Identity Verification: turn on "Verify user emails with cryptographic signatures" and copy the secret key (an owner only; from the Mini plan).

settings.label: Web hook secret
settings.meaning: Checks that a web hook came from Crisp. For a plugin's web hooks, the signing secret Crisp shows; for a website's own web hooks (which Crisp doesn't sign), a random key of your own in the hook's URL.
settings.whereToFind: Plugin hooks: marketplace.crisp.chat › your plugin › Web Hooks: the signing secret shown when the hook is made. Website hooks: any long random string, added to the hook's URL as ?key=… (Settings › Advanced configuration › Web Hooks).

operations.name: people.create
operations.purpose: Adds a people profile: its email (unique on the website) and nickname.

operations.name: people.get
operations.purpose: Reads a people profile by its people_id or by its email.

operations.name: people.update
operations.purpose: Updates the fields given on a people profile, keeping the rest.

operations.name: people.updateData
operations.purpose: Merges custom data keys (strings, numbers, booleans) into a people profile's data.

operations.name: people.addEvent
operations.purpose: Stacks an event on a people profile's timeline: its text, optional data and color.

operations.name: conversations.list
operations.purpose: Lists the website's conversations, a page at a time, optionally only unread, resolved or unresolved, or matching a search.

operations.name: conversations.get
operations.purpose: Reads one conversation: its state, people_id, whether the visitor's email is verified, and its last message.

operations.name: conversations.sendMessage
operations.purpose: Sends a text message, or a private note, in a conversation as an operator.

operations.name: conversations.setState
operations.purpose: Changes a conversation's state: pending, unresolved or resolved.

operations.name: conversations.getMeta
operations.purpose: Reads a conversation's metas: the visitor's nickname, email, phone, data and segments, and the subject.

operations.name: conversations.updateMeta
operations.purpose: Updates the given metas of a conversation: nickname, email, phone, subject, data or segments.

signature.description: Plugin hooks only: X-Crisp-Signature is the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed with the hook's signing secret, of the string [timestamp;body], where timestamp is the X-Crisp-Request-Timestamp header exactly as sent and body is the JSON body as a string (JSON.stringify of the parsed body), with the brackets and semicolon included. Website hooks (set up in the website's settings) aren't signed: Crisp advises a key of your own as a ?key= URL parameter, compared on arrival.

events.meaning: An operator (or the API) sent a message to a visitor.
A conversation's email was set, by the visitor or an operator.
A conversation's custom data was set.
A conversation's state changed (pending, unresolved, resolved).
A conversation was linked to a people profile.
